contexts.text: This protection was represented by... the blood upon the posts and lintel.
Shall put it on the two posts and on the lintel () = the truths and goods of the Natural. The posts of a door = the truths of the Natural. Explained.
Moreover the lintel and posts have a like signification to that of the forehead and hands. AC 2, Illustrated.
That a lintel and posts = the goods and truths of the Natural, through which there is introduction to spiritual things. Illustrated. AC 7921. AC 7927.

He shall bring him either to the door or to the post () = a state of truth confirmed and implanted with spiritual good... A post = the conjunction of that truth with good; for a post is between two chambers, and conjoins them.
Conjunctions are presented to view in Heaven by posts.
The posts are said to tremble (), because posts = the truths of the Natural.
